newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 1.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- French foreign minister says France will come out with a new European initiative to move the peace process in the Middle East.
- Board of directors of the United Arab Emirates' Al-Thuraya satellite telecommunications company agrees to raise its capital to $500 million from $250 million.
- Tunisia establishes a fund to finance small industries.
- An international commercial complex to be established in Qatar at a cost of $375 million in the next five months.
- Arab Development Fund allocates $500 million to finance private sector projects in Arab countries.
- Syrian and Lebanese officials lay the foundation stone of a joint food products plant in Syria.
